question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), 'overpotential|nucleation|bare|%|percent|reduc') ORDER BY page, line_no

WITH a AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'from (\d+) to', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS bare, CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'to (\d+) mV', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS carbon FROM lines WHERE id='p2.L62') SELECT 100.0*(bare-carbon)/bare AS pct_reduction FROM a
